WITH signal_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status') as rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status')
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) as baseline FROM signals
),
kept_statuses AS (
  SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_modindex
  FROM signal_stats s, overall_avg o
  WHERE s.avg_modindex > o.baseline
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as mean_kept FROM kept_statuses
)
SELECT 
  k.rfistat,
  k.avg_modindex,
  k.avg_modindex - o.baseline as above_baseline,
  k.avg_modindex - m.mean_kept as diff_from_mean_kept
FROM kept_statuses k, overall_avg o, kept_mean m
ORDER BY k.rfistat
